datasets.name: network_kpi
queryLines: SELECT SUM(occupied_beds) AS occupied_beds, SUM(bed_capacity) AS bed_capacity, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(occupied_beds) / NULLIF(SUM(bed_capacity), 0), 1) AS utilization_pct FROM ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.bed_utilization

datasets.name: util_by_facility
queryLines: SELECT facility_name, facility_kind, SUM(occupied_beds) AS occupied_beds, SUM(bed_capacity) AS bed_capacity, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(occupied_beds) / NULLIF(SUM(bed_capacity), 0), 1) AS utilization_pct FROM ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.bed_utilization GROUP BY facility_name, facility_kind

datasets.name: occupancy_by_kind
queryLines: SELECT facility_kind, SUM(occupied_beds) AS occupied_beds FROM ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.bed_utilization GROUP BY facility_kind

datasets.name: events_over_time
queryLines: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', event_ts) AS event_hour, CASE WHEN event_type IN ('A01', 'A04') THEN 'Admit' WHEN event_type = 'A03' THEN 'Discharge' ELSE 'Transfer' END AS flow, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.adt_events WHERE event_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: unit_detail
queryLines: SELECT facility_name, unit, patient_class, occupied_beds, bed_capacity, available_beds, utilization_pct FROM ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.bed_utilization

datasets.name: critical_units
queryLines:
SELECT
  facility_name,
  facility_kind,
  unit,
  patient_class,
  occupied_beds,
  bed_capacity,
  available_beds,
  utilization_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN utilization_pct >= 95 THEN 'CRITICAL'
    WHEN utilization_pct >= 85 THEN 'WARNING'
    ELSE 'OK'
  END AS status
FROM
  ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.bed_utilization
WHERE
  utilization_pct >= 85
ORDER BY
  utilization_pct DESC

datasets.name: event_type_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_type,
  CASE
    WHEN event_type IN ('A01', 'A04') THEN 'Admit'
    WHEN event_type = 'A03' THEN 'Discharge'
    WHEN event_type IN ('A02', 'A06', 'A07') THEN 'Transfer'
    WHEN event_type = 'A08' THEN 'Update'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS flow_category,
  facility_code,
  patient_class,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS unique_patients
FROM
  ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.adt_events
WHERE
  event_ts IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3,

datasets.name: hourly_heatmap
queryLines:
SELECT
  DAYOFWEEK(event_ts) AS day_of_week,
  CASE DAYOFWEEK(event_ts)
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Sun'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Mon'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Tue'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wed'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Thu'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Fri'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Sat'
  END AS day_name,
  HOUR(event_ts) AS hour_of_day,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM
  ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.adt_events
WHERE
  event_ts IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,

datasets.name: streaming_freshness
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(inserted) AS last_message_ts,
  COUNT(*) AS total_messages
FROM
  ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.adt_events

datasets.name: length_of_stay
queryLines:
SELECT
  facility_code,
  patient_class,
  unit,
  COUNT(*) AS discharges,
  ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, admit_ts, discharge_ts)), 1) AS avg_los_hours,
  ROUND(MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, admit_ts, discharge_ts)), 1) AS min_los_hours,
  ROUND(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, admit_ts, discharge_ts)), 1) AS max_los_hours
FROM
  ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.adt_events
WHERE
  discharge_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND admit_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND discharge_ts > admit_ts
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,

datasets.name: recent_events
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_ts,
  event_type,
  CASE
    WHEN event_type IN ('A01', 'A04') THEN 'Admit'
    WHEN event_type = 'A03' THEN 'Discharge'
    WHEN event_type IN ('A02', 'A06', 'A07') THEN 'Transfer'
    WHEN event_type = 'A08' THEN 'Update'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS flow,
  facility_code,
  unit,
  room,
  bed,
  patient_class
FROM
  ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.adt_events
WHERE
  event_ts IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  event_ts DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: events_by_source
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(source_system, 'LEGACY') AS source_system,
  CASE
    WHEN event_type IN ('A01', 'A04') THEN 'Admit'
    WHEN event_type = 'A03' THEN 'Discharge'
    WHEN event_type IN ('A02', 'A06', 'A07') THEN 'Transfer'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS flow_category,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM ${resources.schemas.primary.catalog_name}.${resources.schemas.primary.name}.adt_events
GROUP BY 1, 2
